verify_hint: Check sqlglot's `Generator.normalize_func` / `anonymous_sql` for how a quoted anonymous function name (e.g. MySQL `` `myFunc`(x) ``) is rendered with the default normalize_functions.
evidence: Installed sqlglot 30.31.0 (.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/sqlglot-30.31.0.dist-info). parser.py:7662-7665: a quoted function name (TokenType.IDENTIFIER) becomes exp.Anonymous(this=Identifier(quoted=True)). generator.py:4227-4234 anonymous_sql renders self.sql(expression,'this') (the already-quoted text, e.g. `MyFunc`) and passes it to self.func(..., normalize=not is_qualified); for an unqualified name normalize=True. generator.py:4968 func() calls normalize_func(name), and generator.py:1132-1134 upper-cases when normalize_functions is 'upper' or True. generator.py:970-971 sets normalize_functions to the dialect default when None; dialect.py:475 default NORMALIZE_FUNCTIONS='upper' and mysql.py does not override it.
